answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 4513 Country: India Title: Assalam o ailekum, janab mere sawal yeh ki mere waldein Aligarh mein rehte hain aur hamra apna zaati makaan hai, lekin mein 18 saal se Delhi mein rehta aur yahan per bhi mera apna makaan hai, mere sawal yeh hai jab mein aligarh jata hoon to kya mein wahan per Qasar namaz ada karoang ya phir puri namaz parhni hogi. Question: Assalam o ailekum, janab mere sawal yeh ki mere waldein Aligarh mein rehte hain aur hamra apna zaati makaan hai, lekin mein 18 saal se Delhi mein rehta aur yahan per bhi mera apna makaan hai, mere sawal yeh hai jab mein aligarh jata hoon to kya mein wahan per Qasar namaz ada karoang ya phir puri namaz parhni hogi. Answer ID: 4513 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 860/801=D/1429) Aligarh is your native place; it will remain so (i.e. your watan asli ) and you will have to offer full prayers whenever you will be in Aligarh until you leave it and settle in Delhi permanently. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
